objective: Prove repeatable, profitable, evidence-bearing sales loops for Evidex and HOMS before broad product expansion.

phases.name: Contract freeze and registry handshake
acceptance: sample organisation traces from registry to mock order without duplicate identity
unknown and blocked permission states fail the outreach gate

phases.name: Attribution and site instrumentation
acceptance: controlled visit preserves attribution through lead creation and Outlook triage

phases.name: Commerce Core dry run
outputs: order payment fulfilment and delivery projections
acceptance: Evidex golden loop replays from lead capture to commercial receipt
event replay duplicates no commercial object or action

phases.name: PayFast sandbox and verified webhook
acceptance: valid payment releases exactly one fulfilment
duplicate event releases no additional fulfilment
invalid signature amount currency and order references are held

phases.name: First real Evidex commercial loop
acceptance: real lead closes through payment fulfilment review delivery receipt and campaign decision

phases.name: First HOMS commercial loop
acceptance: HOMS order closes with educator approval delivery evidence measured manual time and commercial receipt

phases.name: Demand Loop and weekly experiment gate
acceptance: creative-level paid-order and contribution attribution works

phases.name: Repeatability decision
acceptance: one product reaches repeatable evidence tier or receives a formal pivot or stop decision

evidence_tiers.commercial: at least one verified paid order
evidence_tiers.repeatable: at least three paid orders from at least two campaigns or periods
evidence_tiers.scalable: positive contribution, acceptable fulfilment load and repeatable conversion

north_star: closed paid orders with positive gross contribution and complete evidence lineage
